name: What are the common types of stucco finishes available for re-stucco projects?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of stucco finishes available for re-stucco projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common stucco finishes that can be applied during a re-stucco project, each offering a distinct appearance. These include traditional smooth finishes, which provide a clean and classic look, and various textured finishes like sand float, dash, and worm finishes. Sand float offers a subtle, grainy texture, while dash finishes are rougher with a more pronounced texture. Worm finishes feature grooves that create a unique linear pattern. The choice depends on your desired aesthetic and the architectural style of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common stucco finishes include smooth, sand float, dash, and worm finishes, each offering a distinct texture and appearance for your home's exterior.
